scores.name: Justin Tyme
scores.reason: Moved loose blue bottle onto the recovery shelf and handled target glass, directly linking both possible weapon and delivery site.

assessment.why: Justin alone admits moving the bottle to the precise recovery shelf and lifting the glass. But he says it was the empty copy; laboratory identification and timing are necessary to distinguish innocent photography from poisoning.

plausibility_notes: Bottle and glass handling now make Justin a specific lead; naming it the display copy is an unverified claim, not an exoneration.
